title: 第一卷 第12章 我一个滑铲解决野猪！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

主动发力从歪脖子树上跳了下来，弯刀直指野猪的脖子，打算抹他的喉咙，不能够让这头野猪掌握战斗的节奏。

而且他越是凶猛的摇晃树干，他伤口出血的速度也就越快，他就不信连一个虚弱状态下的野猪他都干不过。

随后只见一记从天而降的刀法。

底下那头正在拱树的野猪，似乎也没有想到秦云居然会这么夸张的落下来，毫无防备的就用脖子接了秦云的弯刀。

弯刀正中咽喉，秦云手腕猛地发力，死死地把弯刀摁了下去。

直接就切进了野猪的咽喉处，野猪那庞大的身躯动作也随之僵硬了一下，随即轰然倒地。

倒地之后，四肢还在不断地抽搐。

鲜血也在这时犹如瀑布一样从咽喉部位喷了出来，直接就给秦云淋成了一个血人。

“真夸张，这些秦岭里头的东西可真有劲，怪不得建国之后不能成精，这玩意要是成精了，那还了得。”

秦云从地上抹了把雪上来，擦拭了一下身上的血液，主要是脸上被喷到的那些猪血，那腥味实在是一般人忍受不了的。

稍微收拾了一下自身，他这才走上前去踢了踢那一头野猪，这头野猪彻底没了反应，悬着的心这才松了下来。

这下，家里有肉吃了。

秦云蹲下身，试着拖了拖野猪的尸体，忍不住皱了皱眉。

这头野猪少说一百八十斤，加上那头五十斤的獐子，总共有两百多斤的猎物。从这儿到青石沟，少说有七八里山路，还是积雪覆盖的崎岖山径。

靠他一个人，根本不可能一次性全扛回去。

但好在他可不是一般人，直接就用弯刀砍断了身后这棵歪脖子树的树枝，也算是让他的生命走到了尽头。

又从旁边割了几段藤蔓下来，三下五除二就做了一个简易的物资托架出来。

随即就把野猪的尸体搬到了托架上，用藤蔓绑紧，拖着朝放置獐子的地点走去。

很快就回到了先前存放物资的地方，把存放的物资也拿上。

便是拖着担架朝着青石沟走去。

虽然说有担架的帮助，但也仅仅只是在雪地上的滑行还算比较顺畅，一旦遇到上坡或者乱石堆就很费劲。

因此一路上秦云也是走走停停，花了差不多两个时辰，在天色将黑之际，才把猎物拖回到了山脚下。

回到了山脚下就好办得多。

这里毕竟有人来人往的痕迹，有一条平整的道路可以供他拖着担架走。

但他拖着这么大的东西，很快就引来了青石沟众多村民的注意。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

He took the initiative to jump down from the crooked neck tree, and pointed the scimitar directly at the wild boar's neck, intending to wipe his throat, but he could not let the wild boar grasp the rhythm of the battle.

And the more ferociously he shook the tree trunk, the faster his wound would bleed. He didn't believe that he couldn't even kill a weak wild boar.

Then I saw a sword technique falling from the sky.

The wild boar that was chopping up the tree didn't seem to expect that Qin Yun would fall down in such an exaggerated manner, and it caught Qin Yun's scimitar with its neck without any precautions.

The scimitar hit his throat. Qin Yun exerted force on his wrist and pressed down the scimitar firmly.

It cut directly into the throat of the wild boar. The wild boar's huge body also stiffened for a moment, and then fell to the ground.

After falling to the ground, his limbs continued to twitch.

At this moment, blood spurted out from his throat like a waterfall, turning Qin Yun into a bloody man.

"It's really an exaggeration. The things in Qinling Mountains are really powerful. No wonder they couldn't become spirits after the founding of the People's Republic of China. If this thing became spirits, it would be fine."

Qin Yun wiped a handful of snow from the ground and wiped the blood on his body, mainly the pig blood that was sprayed on his face. The fishy smell was really intolerable to most people.

After tidying himself up a little, he stepped forward and kicked the wild boar. The wild boar completely stopped responding, and his anxious heart was relieved.

Now, there is meat to eat at home.

Qin Yun knelt down and tried to drag the wild boar's body, but couldn't help but frown.

This wild boar weighed less than 180 kilograms, and together with the fifty kilogram deer, there were more than two hundred kilograms of prey in total.From here to Qingshigou, there is at least seven or eight miles of mountain road, and it is still a rugged mountain path covered with snow.

It is simply impossible for him to carry it all back at once.

But fortunately, he was not an ordinary person. He just used a machete to cut off the branches of the crooked-neck tree behind him, which was considered to be the end of his life.

I cut a few sections of vines from the side and made a simple material tray by dividing three and five by two.

Then he moved the wild boar carcass to the bracket, tied it tightly with vines, and dragged it towards the place where the deer was placed.

He quickly returned to the place where the supplies were previously stored and picked up the stored supplies.

Just dragging the stretcher towards Qingshigou.

Although with the help of a stretcher, the sliding on the snow was relatively smooth. Once it encountered uphill slopes or piles of rocks, it would be very difficult.

Therefore, Qin Yun kept walking and stopping along the way. It took him almost two hours, just as it was getting dark, to drag the prey back to the foot of the mountain.

It's much easier to do once we're back at the foot of the mountain.

After all, there were traces of people coming and going here, and there was a smooth road for him to drag the stretcher along.

But dragging such a big thing quickly attracted the attention of many villagers in Qingshigou.

title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 12 I will kill the wild boar with a sliding shovel!
